ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; no refund (fee was validly incurred under NS-1). No account action against either party.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider states they came out a minute after cancellation, which itself means they were not at the pickup point during the >3 minutes the driver waited; the GPS trace and timeline (I'm Here 17:18:50, cancel 17:22:30, stationary at the pickup point ~30 m away throughout) override the statement and satisfy NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii).
